O4.statement: For each group bucket, count and sum precisely all occurrences of events of that group whose time belongs to the bucket and whose value is non-null; duplicate occurrences each contribute independently.

acceptance_criteria: Positive-count buckets return their sum in either fill mode.
Zero-count buckets return null in fill none.
Zero-count buckets in fill previous return the latest earlier nonempty sum within the same group.
A bucket containing only null-valued events is empty for filling purposes.
Before the first nonempty bucket, fill previous returns null.
